rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for fitness as an exercise or physique-improvement activity.

example.english: I've recently started doing fitness to get in better shape.
example.traditional: 我最近開始做健身，想操好個身。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 hoi1 ci2 zou6 gin6 san1 soeng2 cou1 hou2 go3 san1

rows.note: Use this for the physical fitness or physical capacity someone has, rather than the activity of exercising.

example.english: Is your fitness good enough to handle this mountain trail?
example.traditional: 你嘅體能夠唔夠應付呢條山路？
example.jyutping: nei5 ge3 tai2 nang4 gau3 m4 gau3 jing1 fu6 ni1 tiu4 saan1 lou6

rows.note: Use this for how suitable or appropriate something is.

example.english: We need to assess the fitness of this plan before approving it.
example.traditional: 我哋要睇吓呢個方案嘅適合度，先至可以批。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 tai2 haa5 ni1 go3 fong1 on3 ge3 sik1 hap6 dou6 sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 pai1
